description: This file defines the 'VoiceWakeCommandExtractor' object with a function to extract voice command strings based on trigger words from a given text input. It includes logic for text trimming, trigger matching using regex, and cleaning the extracted command. Additionally, it contains a helper function to identify punctuation characters based on Unicode character types.

classes.name: VoiceWakeCommandExtractor
classes.description: An object providing a static method to extract voice commands based on trigger words from input text.

methods.name: extractCommand
methods.description: Extracts a command string from input text based on a list of trigger words. Returns null if no command is found or input is invalid.
